name: Spokuta
source:
Ukraine, September 2021. Lesya is a girl who has had too many troubles.

Having reached the brink, she attempted suicide, which turned into a real horror.

Unknown shadows began to follow her wherever she went.

What is this - a game of a traumatized psyche or real ghosts?

[Translated from [url=https://moonnovells.itch.io/redemption]itch.io[/url]]
